We developed all the options to open up all the possible approach of the site development and not to resolve 
small details like adding a window or enlarging a room. We believe that the main points like General Buildings Locations, 
General Program, General Building Views, General Requirements are been met with minor exceptions. 
This made us incur losses and costs that exceed our total contract value. 
2- In the last presentation Xavier noted clearly that these Options (especially the third option) needs further 
development and this presentation is to agree on a the General Design Approach. 
3- We were expecting after this last meeting, that you chose One General Scheme / Option and based on which 
we can start the Design Development Phase (with a New Higher Level Detailed Scope of Work, Involvement and 
Contract) to cover the following tasks: 
- Design Development of One Architectural Option 
- Interior Design and Landscape Design Concept Design and further Detailed Design 
- Engaging Engineering Office to work in parallel with us on the Project Design Development (Geotechnical, MEP, 
Structure, Wind Testing, Hurricanes Simulation Modeling, etc,..). We already started our discussions with some. 
- Involving Construction Company to work parallel with us on the Constructability and Logistics Plans and Pre-
Studies. We already started our discussions with some. 
If we agree on high level Option to develop, all your comments and details can be incorporated as we go and 
this is a common practice. But the comments should not hold the Project Development as we have major Constraints 
that we need to look into at this stage if you need to complete this project in 3 to 4 years.

Final company meeting was with Brightseed, an intro from Bart Swanson at Horizon Ventures. They 
have created a computational model, Forager, that mines their proprietary data from the world's plants and human 
biology, discovering natural compounds that solve unmet human problems. In a nutshell, they are able to find these 
compounds, then licence them for manufacture to then be incorporated into everyday foods to enhance people's 
EFTA_R1_01843132 
EFTA02627660
--- PAGE 2 ---
health, naturally. As you can imagine, they have had a lot of inbound from the major US and European food companies 
that are always up against regulators and politicians demanding that their foods are healthier/ not so full of sugar/ have 
more nutrients etc etc. Their model has currently identified one indication, and they are looking to raise a Series A in Q3 
'19 (if not before — they have had some pre-emptive inbound) of around $1S-20m1n to enable them to explore a second 
indication. For me, what they are doing is super interesting, although I found the team a bit flat and not particularly 
inspiring. That may be to do with the fact that they are currently heavily scientist-centric, and will remain so for a while, 
but still didn't really pick up the energy of a team creating an entirely new market.

Final company meeting was with Brightseed, an intro from Bart Swanson at Horizon Ventures. They have 
created a computational model, Forager, that mines their proprietary data from the world's plants and human biology, 
discovering natural compounds that solve unmet human problems. In a nutshell, they are able to find these 
compounds, then licence them for manufacture to then be incorporated into everyday foods to enhance people's 
health, naturally. As you can imagine, they have had a lot of inbound from the major US and European food companies 
that are always up against regulators and politicians demanding that their foods are healthier/ not so full of sugar/ have 
more nutrients etc etc. Their model has currently identified one indication, and they are looking to raise a Series A in Q3 
'19 (if not before — they have had some pre-emptive inbound) of around 515-20mIn to enable them to explore a second 
indication. For me, what they are doing is super interesting, although I found the team a bit flat and not particularly 
inspiring. That may be to do with the fact that they are currently heavily scientist-centric, and will remain so for a while, 
but still didn't really pick up the energy of a team creating an entirely new market.

I thought about you when i saw this if you are interested happy to make an intro 
Final company meeting was with Brightseed, an intro from Bart Swanson at Horizon Ventures. They have created a 
computational model, Forager, that mines their proprietary data from the world's plants and human biology, discovering 
natural compounds that solve unmet human problems. In a nutshell, they are able to find these compounds, then 
licence them for manufacture to then be incorporated into everyday foods to enhance people's health, naturally. As you 
can imagine, they have had a lot of inbound from the major US and European food companies that are always up against 
regulators and politicians demanding that their foods are healthier/ not so full of sugar/ have more nutrients etc etc. 
Their model has currently identified one indication, and they are looking to raise a Series A in Q3 '19 (if not before — they 
have had some pre-emptive inbound) of around $15-20mIn to enable them to explore a second indication. For me, 
what they are doing is super interesting, although I found the team a bit flat and not particularly inspiring. That may be 
to do with the fact that they are currently heavily scientist-centric, and will remain so for a while, but still didn't really 
pick up the energy of a team creating an entirely new market.

Dear Mr. Jeffrey 
We take note of your last 2 emails (the below and attached), in which you expressed your dissatisfaction 
regarding the last Presentation that took place in Paris on the 23rd of January 2019. 
It is with great astonishment; and without emotions, we take note of your comments especially after 
our last productive and positive meeting in Paris. 
We do not question your mode of expression nor your approach but rather respect it. However, we 
consider it as subjective — In Design there is nothing called "Nice" or "Ugly" it is not Engineering or Mathematics where 1 
+ 1 = 2. 
Imagine if Frank Lloyd Wright presented the "Falling Water" House (copy attached) and it was rejected. 
This most important house would have never been built. We want to build you a house to the same level as the "Falling 
Water".

1- Our current involvement is Master Plan with proposed Architecture Character and Space Program 
considering the Project Constraints. 
In good will; and in order to resolve Major Site Constraints and to define the Client's Requirements, we 
went way beyond our contractual obligations and provided you in our last presentation the following: 
- Our Initial Developed Architectural Concept/Approach 
- Two Alternative Architectural Concepts/Approaches 
- As-Built Site 3D Model 
- 3 Optional 3D massing Studies. 
We developed all the options to open up all the possible approach of the site development and not to 
resolve small details like adding a window or enlarging a room. We believe that the main points like General Buildings 
Locations, General Program, General Building Views, General Requirements are been met with minor exceptions. 
This made us incur losses and costs that exceed our total contract value. 
2- In the last presentation Xavier noted clearly that these Options (especially the third option) needs 
further development and this presentation is to agree on a the General Design Approach. 
3- We were expecting after this last meeting, that you chose One General Scheme / Option and based 
on which we can start the Design Development Phase (with a New Higher Level Detailed Scope of Work, Involvement 
and Contract) to cover the following tasks: 
- Design Development of One Architectural Option 
- Interior Design and Landscape Design Concept Design and further Detailed Design 
- Engaging Engineering Office to work in parallel with us on the Project Design Development 
(Geotechnical, MEP, Structure, Wind Testing, Hurricanes Simulation Modeling, etc,..). We already started our discussions 
with some. 
- Involving Construction Company to work parallel with us on the Constructability and Logistics Plans and 
Pre-Studies. We already started our discussions with some.

--- PAGE 4 ---
If we agree on high level Option to develop, all your comments and details can be incorporated as we go 
and this is a common practice. But the comments should not hold the Project Development as we have major 
Constraints that we need to look into at this stage if you need to complete this project in 3 to 4 years. 
4- Regarding your point about the project being too difficult. We are very confident about our 
Experience, we don't believe in the word "difficult". We can Design and Build to you the Best and Biggest Project in the 
World — this is what we are good at. We love challenges and we are experts in resolving it. 
You appointed us to assist you in realizing this project, so we assume that you need to trust us and our 
approach (for sure under your directives and guidance). 
Our projects that we are involved in became master pieces and or projects to be history of countries. 
5- We have no objection to design on site and to setup a design team there — we can discuss such 
involvement details and costs if needed. We believe that this can be a plus, but with our 3D tools that we use we are 
able to simulate the site from our office. 
6- Regarding your point about Xavier's comment to keep the existing pool. I think there is a big 
misunderstanding as for sure we don't want to keep the existing pool and the proof to that is that we eliminated it from 
our 3 options. 
Stating the above, I think it is necessary to clarify our mutual commitments as soon as possible. 
We remain at your disposal to discuss the next step and looking forward to continue working together 
on this exciting project.
